revisions.note: Only a living player reciting the verse triggers the execution. English text: community translation, not official; not yet reviewed by the pack author (2026-09-24).

en.name: Versifier
en.ability: Each night, you learn a word (all from the same line of verse). The 1st time an alive player recites this line, they are executed immediately, even if you are dead.
